skill.name: using-superpowers
skill.description: Guides agents to find, announce, and follow relevant skills before starting tasks, with checklist tracking for skill-required workflows.
skill.summary: Establishes a repeatable workflow for using skills, announcements, and checklist tracking.
skill.author: DYAI2025

security_audit.summary: The static system reconnaissance finding is a false positive caused by workflow prose in SKILL.md. Manual review of SKILL.zip found only a packaged SKILL.md copy, with no executable or exfiltration behavior.

remediation.issue: Packaged zip archive requires manual review by automated scanners.
remediation.suggestion: Publish the plain SKILL.md file without an embedded SKILL.zip copy, or document why the archive is required.

static_findings.snippet: **Many skills contain rigid rules (TDD, debugging, verification).** Follow them exactly. Don't adapt

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 54 describes following rigid workflow rules for skills. It does not perform system reconnaissance, enumerate host data, or request sensitive information.
Manual review showed SKILL.zip contains a single SKILL.md file with the same workflow guidance. No executable payloads, scripts, or hidden files were identified in the archive listing.

low_findings.title: Unscanned file (binary) — manual review required
low_findings.confidence_reasoning: Force-confirmed metadata/low static finding; AI false-positive verdict rejected.

content.value_statement: Agents can miss required skill workflows when tasks start quickly. This skill gives a clear process for finding, announcing, and following relevant skills.
actual_capabilities: Prompts the agent to check for relevant skills before tasks.
Requires reading current skill instructions before use.
Defines a short announcement pattern for skill usage.
Directs checklist-backed skills into tracked todo items.
Explains when to follow rigid workflows or flexible patterns.
limitations: Does not provide task-specific implementation guidance.
Does not run tools, scripts, or external commands by itself.
Depends on compatible skill and todo tooling.
Can add process overhead for very small requests.

use_cases.title: Start Agent Sessions Reliably
use_cases.description: Use a repeatable startup process so relevant skills are found before work begins.

use_cases.title: Keep Checklist Work Visible
use_cases.description: Convert skill checklists into tracked todo items so required steps remain visible.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Agent Behavior
use_cases.description: Give teams a shared process for skill discovery, announcements, and workflow discipline.

prompt_templates.title: Start With Skill Discovery
prompt_templates.prompt: Before helping me, check whether a relevant skill exists. If one applies, read it, announce it, and follow it.

prompt_templates.title: Track Checklist Steps
prompt_templates.prompt: If the selected skill includes a checklist, create a separate todo item for each checklist step before starting work.

prompt_templates.title: Combine Skills For A Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: For this feature request, identify relevant skills, read each applicable skill, and explain which workflow rules govern the work.

prompt_templates.title: Review Workflow Compliance
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the current session for missed skill usage steps, checklist gaps, or skipped announcements, then correct the workflow before continuing.

output_examples.input: Start a new feature request with any relevant skills.
output_examples.output: The assistant identifies the relevant skill, states its use, reads the instructions, and creates checklist todos before implementation.

output_examples.input: Use a testing workflow for this bug fix.
output_examples.output: The assistant announces the testing skill, follows its required workflow, and tracks each checklist step until verification is complete.

output_examples.input: Check whether this session followed the required process.
output_examples.output: The assistant reports which skill steps were followed, which were missed, and what must be corrected before continuing.

best_practices: Read the current skill text before relying on memory.
Create one todo item for each checklist step.
Announce skill usage before applying the workflow.
anti_patterns: Skipping skill discovery because the task seems small.
Following checklist items mentally without tracked todos.
Treating a user request as permission to ignore required workflows.

faq.question: What does this skill help agents do?
faq.answer: It helps agents find, announce, and follow relevant skills before starting task work.

faq.question: Does this skill implement features directly?
faq.answer: No. It defines workflow rules for using other skills and tracking required steps.

faq.question: When should this skill be used?
faq.answer: Use it at the start of a session or task when skill discovery and workflow discipline matter.

faq.question: Does it require todo tooling?
faq.answer: Todo tooling is needed when a selected skill includes a checklist that must be tracked.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is written as general agent workflow guidance for compatible skill systems.

faq.question: What is the main limitation?
faq.answer: It can add process overhead and does not replace task-specific technical skills.
